jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 14개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. 전 세계 유저들의 요구 사항을 분석하여 새로운 기능을 만들고 최첨단 의상 시뮬레이션 기술을 연구해 나갈 패기 넘치는 CLOver*를 모집해요! *CLOver는 전세계 CLO Virtual Fashion 구성원을 뜻하는 호칭이에요 :) 특히 컴퓨터 그래픽스/비전 관련 학위와 일정 수준의 C/C++ 기술을 보유한 여러분의 지원을 기다립니다. You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers.

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description_text:
Senior Data Scientist, Decisions – Autonomous Vehicles

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The future of Lyft is a hybrid network, where autonomous vehicles and human drivers serve riders side by side on one platform. That future has already started. In September 2026, Lyft riders in Nashville were matched with Waymo autonomous vehicles on the Lyft app for the first time. Our partnerships now span Waymo in Nashville, May Mobility in Atlanta and Baidu in Europe, with more on the way.

The Global Growth organization is charting the future of Lyft’s growth beyond North American rideshare’s core products, including bringing Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) to riders domestically and abroad. As a Senior Data Scientist, Decisions for AV, you will be the science partner for the AV product team. You’ll use experimentation and data to decide what we build, how we launch it, and how we know it’s working. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, operations and partnership leaders, and present your recommendations to senior leadership and AV partners.

In this role, you will help us answer questions such as:

  • Rider adoption and trust: What makes a rider choose, accept or opt out of an autonomous ride, and which product changes increase adoption?

For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.

You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences.

You own the vulnerability management lifecycle across our infrastructure, cloud, container and application estate: from discovery and prioritization to validated findings, ready-to-apply fixes and verified closure. You earn trust with engineering teams by being technically right and by making the fix easy. You work closely with the security program manager, platform and infrastructure teams, and application developers, and you help shape how vulnerability management is run at Xsolla as the program matures. Depending on your level, you will either drive the program day to day (Middle) or define its strategy, standards and tooling and mentor others (Senior). Our tech stack includes GCP, vSphere/ESX, Kubernetes and container workloads, MariaDB, CockroachDB, Go, PHP, and Python. jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 - Policy Data Analyst Intern - Empire Center for Public Policy
jobs.description_text: The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early! The Empire Center is looking for a talented individual for our policy data analyst role.
